apps.subtitle: Windows games on iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription: A fast, controller-friendly launcher that runs Windows games on iOS and iPadOS with Steam and GOG built in, powered by Wine, FEX and Metal via DXMT.

versions.localizedDescription:
**BCD is in alpha:** an early stage of development, before beta. Many games run, many do not yet, and things can break between builds. When a game fails, please send a log.

## ✨ New

- **Send Log asks what happened.** When you send a log (Settings › Send Log, a game's page, or after auto-tune), a box lets you add a few words: what the log cannot show, such as low FPS and where, a stutter, or what was on screen. Leave it empty to send the log alone. Please don't write personal details.
- **Games on an external SSD (experimental).** Settings › Storage › External SSD: pick a folder on a USB-C drive in the Files picker, and BCD shows it to Windows as `C:\External`, so you can add games that live there without copying them to the phone. **Reconnect** opens the saved folder again with one tap. Nothing changes until you pick a folder. On some iOS versions the folder picker may not answer; if that happens, please send a log. Thanks to Pardoxum (#12).
- **Diablo II: Resurrected:** BCD now has the engine changes its loader needs (executable shared sections, two code-probe recoveries, and more), switched on only for this game. It has not been tested on a device yet; if it still stops, please send a log. Thanks to mckenna654 (#4).
- **Minecraft Dungeons II:** recommended settings, and a fix for programs that open their files through `\\?\GLOBALROOT` paths. Thanks to le0-VV (#16).

## Other improvements

> **Tried one of these games on an earlier build? Reset its settings first.** A game keeps the settings it had until you reset them, so without this it may start with the old ones that failed. On the game's page: **Options › Recommended settings › Reset to Recommended**, then check that **Options › Auto-tune › Auto-tune this game** is on, and start the game again.

These fix failures found in the logs you sent with Send Log since 0.1.592. Each fix targets the error a log showed; most could not be tested on a device yet, so a game may now get further and still stop at a later point. If it does, please send a new log: it names the next problem.

- **Marvel's Spider-Man Remastered:** the black screen after start is fixed (a Direct3D 12 command the game waits on was missing).
- **64-bit Direct3D 9 games** (Darksiders II Deathinitive Edition, MudRunner, Indivisible, Counter-Strike: Source in 64-bit) could not create a graphics device; their recommended settings now draw them through DXMT.
- **Fallout 4 and The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition** (Steam): the launcher Steam starts could not start a second copy of itself, so the game never came up. BCD now starts the game in the launcher's place (nothing in the game's folder changes). **Skyrim:** the dialogue did not play; its voice lines now get the WMA decoder they need.
- **Dying Light:** "Cannot initialize renderer" at start: the renderer imports DirectDraw, which its recommended settings now add.
- **Resident Evil 6 and Resident Evil Revelations 2:** with Direct3D 9 set to Native ARM64 they closed 2-4 s after the first frame; their recommended settings use the standard Direct3D 9 path.
- **Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice:** closed about 20 s into the start for want of the Japanese code page; its recommended settings add it.
- **Risk of Rain 2:** closed 8 s into the start (its controller plugin); its recommended settings add the Windows library it needed.
- **Stardew Valley:** no window appeared (.NET's code patching on itself); its recommended settings fix the memory operation behind it.
- **Glyphica: Typing Survival:** closed at once (its JavaScript engine read a Windows security setting that was left unwritten); its recommended settings fix it.
- **Batman: Arkham City:** started from its launcher (BmLauncher.exe), the game's recommended settings were not applied; now they are.
- **Grand Theft Auto V and Red Dead Redemption 2 from Epic:** Rockstar's launcher stopped with error 113, taking the game for a Steam copy; BCD no longer tells it so.
- **GOG downloads:** in some regions the install stopped at once with *"GOG's reply wasn't what BCD expects"* (GOG named a download server outside gog.com); BCD now reads the same file from GOG's own server.
- **Heavy Direct3D 12 games** (GTA V, RDR2, Ghost of Tsushima, God of War, Horizon, Spider-Man and others): when the GPU resets, auto-tune now says to set every graphics option to its lowest and turn MSAA off, which is what fixed a freeze in GTA V.
- **Auto-tune explains more stops:** a 32-bit game on an install without the Increased Memory Limit and extended virtual addressing cannot get the address space it needs (Far Cry 3, Metro 2033: use GetMoreRam or a paid developer account); Cuphead on phones whose GPU cannot read compressed textures (iPhone 14 Pro class) runs out of memory; and a freeze seen in OMORI, ONE PIECE Bounty Rush, Saints Row IV and Demons Roots is now named (logs from this build show where it happens).
- **Wine desktop:** pressing the Start button could end the whole session; fixed. The Start menu now has an Explorer entry and Direct3D 9/10/11/12 test programs.
- **32-bit programs that start many helpers:** windows left behind by programs that had ended are given back to new ones.
- **The interface:** auto-tune's question no longer closes a game page you have open (it waits until you are back on the library); config editors have a **Done** button on the keyboard; landscape can be locked (in Settings, and per game); the game page names the graphics API of Unity games and of games that load Direct3D 12 at run time.
- **More detail in logs** for LEGO Batman: The Videogame, Silent Hunter 3, Just Cause 3, Need for Speed: Most Wanted and Underground 2, Chuchel, Botanicula, Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc, BioShock Infinite (Epic) and Terraria. If you play one of them, a log from this build helps.
- **Known issue:** Frame generation (experimental) with MetalFX upscaling can make the graphics driver stop the game after a minute or two. Turn Frame generation off for now.

Install help, game reports and ideas: the BCD-Games Discord is open, https://discord.gg/43TmupTVug

**BCD.ipa**: the unsigned IPA, for sideloading with SideStore, AltStore or LiveContainer. It needs iOS 18 or later and JIT; the README has the details.
**BCD-source.tar.xz**: the complete source of this build with all its submodules (GPL-3.0).
